name: Akutagawa Ryutarou
source:
"I'm sorry, but please stay with me for a while."

The head of flower arrangement who is popular with women. He is a man of few words and people never know what he's thinking.

He likes coffee and goes to the cafe several times a week. He is childhood friends with Hiratsuka.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/irohanihoheto/%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9-1]offiical website[/url]]
